title: OL-20261114-1: MCP registry publish waits on GitHub Actions billing
body:
**Owner:** marketing-manager
**Trigger:** Actions jobs run again, or Q-PROMO-mcp-registry taken
**Done check:** grep:ops/promotion/outcomes.jsonl::mcp-registry
**Status:** closed

mcp-registry.yml publishes via GitHub OIDC; every Actions job is refused for billing (existing NEEDS-YOU card). Second route: DNS-key login for io.ultrastable from the tick Worker (Q-PROMO-mcp-registry).

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 169.6 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
